Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:13:00 -0000
Subject: Offline update signer rehearsal & network quarantine checklist

Team / OpsSec,

We need to run a full rehearsal for the islanded-site image refresh next week. Goal is to validate the entire offline path: signing, manifest verification, courier acceptance, and the network quarantine step at the customer edge. Key asks:

- Marissa: runbook owner — can you confirm the rehearsal-play timeline and the operator checklist in the attached PDF? (rehearsal-checklist.pdf)
- Karthik: update the signing chain diagram with the change to rotating operator keys (image-manifest-v3.json.sig attached).
- Priyom: coordinate with SafeHaul for courier ETA and acceptance form (courier-eta.xlsx).
- OpsSec: we need a short list of telemetry we can collect at the secure site without breaking isolation (audit-only signals, local timestamping).

Proposed window: Tue 2027-05-25 09:00–12:00 PDT. If that works for Acme's ops lead, we'll run the full acceptance drill and produce a signed provenance statement.

Notes: this is an exercise — no production image promotion. Please flag if you think the rehearsal needs to be shortened or split into two discrete drills (signing + physical handoff).

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Senior PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rehearsal-checklist.pdf, image-manifest-v3.json.sig, courier-eta.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, OpsSec (EdgeCloud) <opssec@edgecloud.io>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Offline update signer rehearsal & network quarantine checklist

Thanks Michael — I reviewed the checklist and proposed a tightened run order. See inline changes below and the attached annotated PDF.

- Start with local signing ceremony (15m) — verify operator fingerprint and chain-of-trust mapping.
- Manifest verification (20m) — include a deliberate mismatch test (fail fast) to confirm operator rollback behavior.
- Sealed courier handoff (30m) — acceptance form signed by operator and courier; photograph of courier seal logged to the local ledger.
- Network quarantine (40m) — bring the target node online in a private VLAN; allow only 3 outbound telemetry endpoints (time-server + ops-probe endpoints).

I've added a short emergency rollback ladder in the checklist (pages 4–5). Also: recommend we run the mismatch test as an optional step before the handoff (keeps the acceptance flow simple for first run).

On the manifest: Karthik, I made a suggestion to add a short, human-readable provenance blob to the JSON (operator id + rehearsal id). That will make the failure mode easier to debug on-site.

Marissa
Director, Field Deployments
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 13:47:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Offline update signer rehearsal & network quarantine checklist

All — I updated the manifest and signing notes. Summary of changes:  

1) Manifest now includes a lightweight provenance field: {"provenance": "operator:m_cole; rehearsal:20270525-01"} (we'll strip this in production but keep for rehearsals).
2) Added verifier behavior: on manifest mismatch, operator UI must surface exact failing digest and block acceptance unless operator acknowledges a forced-override with a second signing key.
3) Operator key rotation schedule: rehearsal will use ephemeral operator keys (valid 24h) and a root signing key held in hardware at Redwood HQ. We'll log the root-key signature in the attached image-manifest-v3.json.sig.

OpsSec — for quarantine telemetry, propose the following minimal set: NTP sync status, package signature verification result (pass/fail), operator-ack id, and courier seal-id hash. These are audit-only and can be shipped off-site in a batched, encrypted envelope after acceptance. If that set looks acceptable, I'll fold it into the runbook.

Karthik
Sr. Security Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference
